## December 12, 2025

## RBI approves the voluntary amalgamation of Amarnath Co-operative Bank Ltd.,

## Ahmedabad, Gujarat with The Kalupur Commercial Co-operative Bank Ltd.,

## Ahmedabad, Gujarat

The Reserve Bank of India, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-section

(4) of Section 44A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of Amarnath Co-operative Bank Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat with The Kalupur Commercial Co-operative Bank Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The Scheme will come into force with effect from December 15, 2025 (Monday). All the branches of Amarnath Co-operative Bank Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat will function as branches of The Kalupur Commercial Co- operative Bank Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat with effect from December 15, 2025.
## (Brij Raj)
